base.description: The foundational color that defines the theme's identity. Used for branding elements or accent pieces.

primary.description: Main interactive color derived from the base. Used for primary buttons, links, and active states.

secondary.description: Complementary color to the primary. Used for secondary actions, highlights, or accents.

accent.description: Complementary to the base color, typically with a hue shift. Used for visual interest, highlights, or to direct attention to specific elements.

grad-1.description: Linear gradient from base to accent color, flowing from top-left to bottom-right. Useful for decorative backgrounds, cards, or buttons that need visual emphasis.

grad-2.description: Linear gradient from base to accent color, flowing from left to right. Good for horizontal elements like headers, footers, or horizontal separators.

surface-1.description: Primary background color. Used for the main page background.

surface-2.description: Secondary background color. Used for cards, sidebars, and other container elements.

surface-3.description: Tertiary background color. Used for nested containers or to create subtle depth.

surface-4.description: Contrast background color. Used for elements that need to stand out from other surfaces.

border-2.description: Light border color. Used for subtle separators and dividers.

border-3.description: Medium border color. Used for default borders on containers and form elements.

border-4.description: Heavy border color. Used for emphasis or focus states.

primary.description: Main text color. Used for body text and headings. Not tinted with the base color.

secondary.description: Secondary text color. Used for supporting information like subtitles, descriptions, or secondary content. Can be tinted with the base color.

inverted.description: Contrasting text color. Used for text on dark backgrounds or interactive elements. Not tinted with the base color.

disabled.description: Text color for disabled elements. Used to indicate that an element is not interactive. Can be tinted with the base color.

base.description: Primary success color. Used for success messages, confirmations, and positive states.

light.description: Light success color. Used for success backgrounds or subtle indicators.

dark.description: Dark success color. Used for interactive success elements like buttons.

base.description: Primary error color. Used for error messages, alerts, and negative states.

light.description: Light error color. Used for error backgrounds or subtle indicators.

dark.description: Dark error color. Used for interactive error elements like buttons.

base.description: Primary warning color. Used for warning messages, alerts, and cautionary states.

light.description: Light warning color. Used for warning backgrounds or subtle indicators.

dark.description: Dark warning color. Used for interactive warning elements like buttons.

base.description: Primary info color. Used for informational messages and neutral states.

light.description: Light info color. Used for info backgrounds or subtle indicators.

dark.description: Dark info color. Used for interactive info elements like buttons.

base.description: Primary caution color. Used for less severe warning states.

light.description: Light caution color. Used for caution backgrounds or subtle indicators.

dark.description: Dark caution color. Used for interactive caution elements like buttons.

sm.description: Base text size, standard small text
